_comment: Phase H. Dev-only advisories with NO patched release in the installed major line. Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs; an entry past review_by fails CI. Runtime (shipped) dependencies can never be allowlisted -- the gate fails on any runtime advisory first.

advisories.reason: Build-time only: braces expands the glob patterns in our own tailwind.config.js `content` list, never user input, and is absent from the shipped bundle (npm audit --omit=dev = 0). No patched braces release exists (latest 3.0.3 is in range); the only fix npm offers is the Tailwind 3 -> 4 rewrite of the CSS toolchain, tracked as a limitation in docs/LIFELINK_PHASE_H_SECURITY_REPORT.md.
